merge_policy: Owner-authorized sequential merges regardless of absent, queued, pending or failing CI. Original base branches preserved; expected reviewed head supplied to supported merge operation. No protection or security control disabled.
ci_coverage: The workflow helper returns the first page of pull-request-triggered Actions runs. An empty list means no runs were returned by that helper, not proof that every GitHub check passed. The earliest PR2619 CI snapshot was not retained.

focused_checks.result: Three regressions reproduced on baseline and pass after locking; focused Ruff/mypy pass.
48 combined backend/expiry/journal tests pass; targeted Ruff and mypy pass.
20 key tests; selected audit guard functions, census/suppression checks, parity error case and command batching verified. Full platform matrix not run.
23 focused tests pass; 80 additive OpenAPI header entries checked.
47 integrated tests pass; later 15 eval/usage/receipt checks pass with locked polars1.44.2.
Five focused cases pass (four failed on baseline); full-audit cases were deselected.
16 recovery cases pass (all16 failed on baseline); complete webhook all-probes test passed on compatible source overlay.
26 combined lifecycle/resource/webhook cases pass; nine resource fault regressions covered; targeted Ruff pass.
31 focused cases and real API mint/patch/rotate/auth/restart smoke pass; two formatting issues corrected before publication.
Seven focused cases pass; both complete HTTP and SDK examples exit0 including receipt verification. HTTP key revocation/drain checked.
14 native SDK/cursor/receipt/mutation cases pass on post2727 composition; 92-path OpenAPI matches snapshot; focused Ruff/typing pass.
Targeted claim/replay/state checks and two-worker starvation reproduction pass; merged into original feature base, not main.
Current GARCH-MIDAS five-test module passes with both available and exact locked NumPy/SciPy. Negative theta is allowed by the model; stale test assertion already corrected.
Seven current CLI smoke checks pass; exact registry function produces expected four tag calls; current CI installs all extras. Torch-heavy and full doctor tests not rerun.
51 composed store/state/cursor/replay cases passed; one empty-audit-result regression passed; scoped Ruff/format and exact published blob verification passed.

186 of 186 probes passed in one 49.67-second run. New distinct SYNTHETIC receipt verified; native OpenAPI and normalized surface exactly match snapshots. The tested complete tree matches published #2801 head 816c88467792cf994fa1ca24c303d74304ce6d32 (tree 08785154226ecab69e5ce7e87f4b432fb5fe2b95); this run predates the later #2748 changes. Runtime versions and transport limitations are recorded in the linked evidence.

49/49 probes passed in 12.50 seconds after validation-helper extraction. The only later probe-source-file change was a nonempty aggregation guard: its regression failed before the fix and passed afterward; all probe implementations stayed unchanged. Seven validation cases and scoped Ruff/format passed.

coverage_gaps: Full frozen make sync and full make lint/typecheck/test/fx1-test/fx1-gate were not run. Targeted checks used recorded isolated dependencies; the full buffered stream run included Starlette 1.7.0 and was not an exact-lock environment.
GitHub security, Dependabot and secret-alert feeds were not exposed through the available approved connector operations. Queued CodeQL/secret-scan workflows are not completed security-scan results.
cargo-audit was unavailable. Rust OSV results exclude yanked-package and Cargo-specific coverage.
The separate partly unpinned third_party/kronos environment was not resolved or audited.
Actual network early-disconnect propagation, deletion during a live network response, and streaming delivery timing remain unverified; the 186-probe audit uses a buffering ASGI test transport.

Journal locking coordinates one instance, not multiple independent processes. Missing-file or valid-history rollback requires an independent trusted anchor. Provider-completion/charge crash boundaries remain outside transactional guarantees.

Key-recovery tombstones count toward the existing 4096-key capacity; a completely exhausted store needs explicit operator capacity recovery. Durable quota writes add I/O and were not throughput-benchmarked.

Research generator hardcoded paths, import side effects, idempotence/validation and duplication debt remain beyond focused repairs. SYNTHETIC Boolean fixtures do not establish model or market performance.

No full line-level audit of the repository, all numerical models, or every failing workflow log was performed. Current workflow completion and full platform status cannot be inferred from local checks.

record_boundary.description: Contains only merges confirmed before this evidence commit. PR #2804 carries this record and is excluded from its own pre-merge count; consult GitHub for its final merge result.

source_fixes.change: Serialize journal append and replay counter state under the instance lock; prevent broken hash chains and concurrent replay resets.
Reject non-integer provider usage and invalid expiry values; authorize scopes before charging counters; retain streaming key attribution; distinguish hard quotas from retryable rate windows.

Publish key rotation only after its durable journal record. Quarantine credentials after detected journal damage, retain authenticated recovery across empty/zero-byte journals, and persist accepted request/token accounting.
Prevent recovered callback delivery without retained signing secrets; deduplicate terminal delivery; close both evaluation backends and release capacity on cleanup/journal failures.

Keep SSE replay cursors monotonic; atomically claim queued work/cancellation; reject late resurrection and stale terminal writes; serialize idempotent submissions while retaining claim ownership through worker cancellation.
Turn unhashable enum input into shape violations and deeply nested invalid JSON into a bounded structured refusal, retaining request identifiers.
Bound quickstart startup and propagate server-thread failures; preserve prebound sockets; correct SDK pagination and validate actual forwarded sampling parameters.
Repair research registrations, preserve earlier documentation/features through conflicts, and fix concrete guard/fixture/platform issues while keeping integrity requirements intact.
Add the omitted nested FX1 TypeScript client to make audit-js, covering all four npm lockfiles.
